name: otelcol.exporter.googlecloudpubsub

arguments.name: topic
arguments.description: The topic name to send OTLP data over. The topic name should be a fully qualified resource name, for example, projects/otel-project/topics/otlp.

arguments.name: compression
arguments.description: The compression used on the data sent to the topic. Only gzip is supported. Default is no compression.

arguments.name: endpoint
arguments.description: Override the default Pub/Sub endpoint. This is useful when connecting to the Pub/Sub emulator instance or switching between global and regional service endpoints.

arguments.name: insecure
arguments.description: Allows performing insecure SSL connections and transfers. This is useful when connecting to a local emulator instance. Only has effect if you set endpoint.

arguments.name: timeout
arguments.description: Timeout for calls to the Pub/Sub API.

arguments.name: universe_domain
arguments.description: Universe domain for the Pub/Sub service. Set to support Sovereign Cloud regions.

arguments.name: user_agent
arguments.description: Override the user agent string used for Pub/Sub requests. Specify {{version}} to include the application version number.
